title: Coordinate noise probability mass function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $x\in\Omega$, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. The coordinate noise probability mass function is the mixture that retains $x$ with probability $\rho$ and otherwise draws a new value according to $\pi$.
